stops.title: Nsiesieeɛ
stops.caption: Mpɔtam, na asɔre mmaa.
stops.speech: Nsiesieeɛ firi mpɔtam so, na asɔre mmaa a ɛwɔ mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔmanfoɔ biara ne kuo biara wɔ asɔre baa bi ase.

stops.title: W’asɔre baa a ɛdi kan
stops.caption: To no din, si no, di n’anim.
stops.speech: Fa din, kurow ne ɔsom berɛ ma asɔre baa no, na fa ne sɔfoɔ ma. Asɔrefoɔ bɛtumi aba akyire yi.
